messages:
hana: Quick sync — Borealis marketplace listing and partner HW SKU. T-48h to embargo. Need owners: assets, SI validation, pricing, legal quote.

ryan: I’ll own SI validation and the test run. Slot scheduled tomorrow 10:00 PT. Will need Borealis firmware engineer on call.

jo: Asset pack arrived but hero is low-res. I can accept placeholders; final must be 2x retina by cutover. CDN path will be s3://borealis-assets/marketplace/5211/ when complete.

marie: Landing copy in /staging/marketplace/borealis/ — pushed draft, awaiting hero to finalize above-the-fold. Legal wants a 1-sentence quote (performance + partnership). Please nudge partner.

ryan: Short SI runbook:
```
- git checkout release/borealis-marketplace
- deploy connector v1.7.0
- run smoke: ./ci/smoke.sh --sku BORE-EDGE
- run int: ./ci/integrate.sh --env staging --partner borealis
- verify: grep \"handshake complete\" /var/log/redwood/connector.log
- upload results to Partnerships/Borealis/tests/
```
Fallback: if firmware mismatch, publish listing with badge \"integration pending\" and disable one-click deploy.

deploy-bot: preview-check started (job 14021)
deploy-bot: preview-check passed ✅ no broken links

jo: Uploaded placeholders to https://cdn.redwood.example/partners/borealis/5211/ ; will replace with hi-res by 08:00 PT tomorrow.

ryan: Reserved 3 GPUs for load test at 10:00 PT. Will post screenshots and logs here.

marie: Analytics ticket INF-8610 created to ensure events include partner.sku and partner.region.

hana: Embargo set for 2026-05-25T17:00:00Z. All assets + legal signoff required by T-24h. If clear by 09:00 PT tomorrow we mark \"launch-ready\" and run final dry-run at 10:00 PT. Document results in Partnerships/Marketplace/Borealis/launch-playbook.md. Thanks team.
